endpoint.label: Log endpoint
endpoint.description: Full URL of the Listening Habits ingest endpoint, e.g. https://example.org/api/listens

home_place_name.label: Home place name
home_place_name.description: Place recorded for players that live in one room. Leave blank to record no place.

weather_entity.label: Home Assistant weather entity
weather_entity.description: Current conditions to save with each listen. If unavailable, Music Assistant falls back to Open-Meteo using Home Assistant's home coordinates.

manifest.description: Pushes every play to a self-hosted Listening Habits log, with real negotiated audio quality and live stream metadata.
